title: LfGrowBOT
tagline: LFGrowBOT is a Discord BOT to query LENS PROTOCOL trying to onboard users using the API in a simple way.
description: LFGrowBOT is a Discord BOT to query LENS PROTOCOL. LENS PROTOCOL is built with modularity in mind, allowing new features to be added while ensuring immutable user-owned content and social relationships, this bot try to onboard users using the API in a simple way. Using Discord.js and simple commands.
